agent_explanation: Seeded sensor noise on theta/omega causes state-feedback controller to apply wrong-direction growing forces (28.7 at step10, 47.2 at step15, saturated 52.2 at steps18-19). Energy pumped from ~1.98 to 34.1 to 40.3 while cart velocity runs away to -8.35 m/s, swinging pole from -0.05 to +0.80 rad. With zero noise the same plant/initial condition stays balanced, showing noise-induced destabilization not plant instability.
